title: The Joint Committee of Structural Safety: past, present and a perspective on the future
editors: Maria Pina Limongelli, Michael Havbro Faber, Jochen Köhler, and Ton Vrouwenvelder
search_text: literature-2025-jcss-anniversary The Joint Committee of Structural Safety: past, present and a perspective on the future 2025-03  Maria Pina Limongelli, Michael Havbro Faber, Jochen Köhler, and Ton Vrouwenvelder Special issue Structural Safety 113   https://www.sciencedirect.com/journal/structural-safety/vol/113/suppl/C https://www.jcss-lc.org/publicationsjcss/jcss-special-issue-50th-anniversary-of-structural-safety/ JCSS anniversary announcement 2025 This anniversary issue marks fifty years of JCSS work on structural safety and considers its future development. Contributions examine the committee’s history, the development of structural reliability methods, and proposed advances to the Probabilistic Model Code. Together, they connect the organisation’s work with the methods and probabilistic models used in structural design and assessment. Selected papers from the issue are listed below.

title: Structural Safety 19(3): JCSS papers
search_text: literature-1997-jcss-papers Structural Safety 19(3): JCSS papers 1997  Journal issue Structural Safety 19(3)   https://www.sciencedirect.com/journal/structural-safety/vol/19/issue/3 https://www.jcss-lc.org/publicationsjcss/ JCSS publications catalogue 1997 Devoted to the work of JCSS, this issue brings together an early account of the Probabilistic Model Code and studies of the methods supporting probabilistic design.
